title: Aromatic Jamaican Sausage Gratin
description: A garlicky, solo-dinner Jamaican dish featuring German sausages, this gratin is perfect for a quiet night in, with a glassy-jelly topping and deep-fry-tod crunch, all in an individual mini cocotte, following ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the German sausage into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a small pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic, allspice, thyme, and scotch bonnet pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, mix the vegetable broth and bread crumbs together.
In an individual mini cocotte, create a layer of sausage, followed by a layer of the onion and garlic mixture, and finally a layer of the bread crumb mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of bread crumb mixture on top.
Place the cocotte in the oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sausage is cooked through.
Remove the cocotte from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
